title: seseli elatum subsp. austriacum
intro: Seseli elatum subsp. austriacum, commonly known as Austrian mountain carrot, is a plant species within the carrot family, native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, making it useful in the treatment of various conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties, suggesting its potential in the management of infections and inflammatory disorders. The bioactive constituents of Seseli elatum subsp. austriacum include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its pharmacological activities.
